description: This file contains test fixture code for PlaybackService, including mock setup, shared memory handling, and test scenarios for the PlaybackService class in a media playback system.

classes.name: PlaybackServiceTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for PlaybackService, providing setup, mock expectations, and utility methods for testing PlaybackService.

methods.name: sharedMemoryBufferWillBeInitialized
methods.description: Sets expectation that the shared memory buffer factory will create a shared memory buffer.

methods.name: sharedMemoryBufferWillReturnFdAndSize
methods.description: Sets expectations for the shared memory buffer mock to return specific file descriptor and size.

methods.name: createPlaybackServiceShouldSuccess
methods.description: Initializes the PlaybackService instance with mocked dependencies, expecting successful creation.

methods.name: triggerSwitchToActive
methods.description: Calls switchToActive() on the PlaybackService instance.

methods.name: triggerSwitchToInactive
methods.description: Calls switchToInactive() on the PlaybackService instance.

methods.name: triggerSetMaxPlaybacks
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of playbacks in the PlaybackService.

methods.name: triggerSetMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of Web Audio players in the PlaybackService.

methods.name: triggerSetClientDisplayName
methods.description: Sets the client display name in the PlaybackService.

methods.name: getSharedMemoryShouldSucceed
methods.description: Verifies that getSharedMemory() returns true and the correct fd and size.

methods.name: getSharedMemoryShouldFail
methods.description: Verifies that getSharedMemory() returns false and fd and size are zero.

methods.name: getShmBufferShouldSucceed
methods.description: Checks that getShmBuffer() returns a non-null pointer.

methods.name: getMaxPlaybacksShouldSucceed
methods.description: Verifies that getMaxPlaybacks() returns the expected maximum.

methods.name: getMaxWebAudioPlayersShouldSucceed
methods.description: Verifies that getMaxWebAudioPlayers() returns the expected maximum.

methods.name: clientDisplayNameShouldBeSet
methods.description: Checks that the client display name environment variable is correctly set and then unsets it.
